data.long_description:
Presenting a beautifully designed 4-bedroom villa in the prestigious District One community, offering both luxury and strong investment potential. This unfurnished property features a BUA of 3,923 sq ft on a 3,490 sq ft plot, with modern finishes and spacious interiors.


Property Features:

4 En-suite Bedrooms
5 Bathrooms, including a guest powder room
Fully fitted kitchen with premium Miele appliances
Maid’s room and separate storage room
Contemporary interiors with high-end finishings
Built-in wardrobes in all bedrooms
2 covered parking spaces

District One is known for its exclusivity, lush green surroundings, and world-class amenities. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai, this villa is a rare opportunity to own a home in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities.
